## Testing Mode
GREEN

## Story DD Coverage
This task is responsible for satisfying the following story done definitions:
- dd-8: The full test suite passes (FAILED: 0) under `bash tests/run-all.sh` with the new migration-class-detect and planning-config call-site-threshold suites registered.

Consolidation task. Registers the two test suites authored by task-1 and task-3 with the suite runner, verifies fuzzy-match basename normalization resolves both files, adds a `.test-index` entry if the runner requires explicit registration, ensures both new `.sh` test files carry the executable bit, and asserts the full suite is green (FAILED: 0) under `bash tests/run-all.sh`. This task introduces no production conditional logic of its own — it only wires already-authored suites into the runner and asserts the aggregate green state.

## Test Exemption
This task is exempt from authoring new tests on two grounds:

- Unit exemption criterion 1 (no new conditional logic of its own): this task adds no production branches, helpers, or classification logic. It only registers existing suites with the runner and sets the executable bit on already-authored test files. There is no new behavior of this task's own to unit-test.
- Integration exemption criterion 1 (the existing test is cited by explicit file path): the suites this task registers and asserts are the already-authored existing tests `plugins/dso/tests/hooks/lib/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh` (authored by task-1) and `plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh` (authored by task-3). This task's value is proven by executing those two existing suites under `bash tests/run-all.sh` and asserting FAILED: 0 — no new integration test need be authored here.

## Acceptance Criteria
- [ ] Unit tests pass (exit 0)
  Verify: TEST_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.test_unit) && [ -n "$TEST_CMD" ] && $TEST_CMD
- [ ] Lint passes (exit 0)
  Verify: LINT_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.lint) && [ -n "$LINT_CMD" ] && $LINT_CMD
- [ ] Format check passes (exit 0)
  Verify: FORMAT_CHECK_CMD=$(.claude/scripts/dso read-config commands.format_check) && [ -n "$FORMAT_CHECK_CMD" ] && $FORMAT_CHECK_CMD
- [ ] The migration-class-detect suite runs green under the runner
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test-migration-class-detect' && bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] The planning-config call-site-threshold suite runs green under the runner
  Verify: bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'test-planning-config-call-site-threshold' && bash tests/run-all.sh 2>&1 | grep -q 'FAILED: 0'
- [ ] Both new test files carry the executable bit
  Verify: test -x plugins/dso/tests/hooks/lib/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh && test -x plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh

## File Impact
- Edit: plugins/dso/tests/hooks/lib/test-planning-config-call-site-threshold.sh
- Edit: plugins/dso/tests/implementation-plan/test-migration-class-detect.sh

## Retry Budget
MAX_ATTEMPTS: 3 (sonnet model)
On 3 consecutive sonnet failures: escalate to opus with full diagnostic context (all 3 failure messages)
On 3 consecutive opus failures (6 total): escalate to user with full failure history
If MAX_AGENTS: 0 at sonnet→opus escalation time: skip opus step, escalate to user immediately
